arguments.question: Across ANET, MU, META and NVDA, assess the latest reported operating/financial trajectory, material company-specific catalysts and risks relevant to 21/63 sessions. For QQQ, use the dated sponsor profile/holdings to identify look-through concentration and overlap with these names. Provide only source-supported facts, distinguish inferences, and identify critical missing data. Stopping criterion: review the registered SEC/company sources and QQQ profile/holdings; do not pursue unsupported consensus estimates.
arguments.decision_impact: Could determine whether each company has a differentiated fundamental catalyst/risk and whether QQQ adds or concentrates exposure, rather than treating all five as a single AI/megacap thesis.
